sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: Italy about to see the country's most right-wing government since World War II.
sentences.zh: 意大利即将迎来二战以来最右翼的政府。

sentences.en: Georgia Maloney.
sentences.zh: 乔治亚·梅洛尼。

sentences.en: Her party, Brothers of Italy, draws its roots from Italy's fascist history.
sentences.zh: 她的政党“意大利兄弟党”根植于意大利的法西斯历史。

sentences.en: A year ago, Italian far-right politician Georgia Maloney became prime minister on an agenda that many feared would mark a radical turn for Italy.
sentences.zh: 一年前，意大利极右翼政治家乔治亚·梅洛尼凭借一项议程当选总理，许多人担心这将标志着意大利的激进转向。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'm very pleased to be here today to testify a big friendship that bonds the United States and Italy.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴今天能在这里见证美意两国之间深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: I want to thank President Biden for his hospitality.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢拜登总统的热情款待。

sentences.en: Last week, she visited the White House for the first time.
sentences.zh: 上周，她首次访问了白宫。

sentences.en: And this closeness is based on common values and cultural roots.
sentences.zh: 这种亲密关系建立在共同的价值观和文化根基之上。

sentences.en: A move that bolsters her credentials on the international stage.
sentences.zh: 此举巩固了她在国际舞台上的地位。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Rome bureau chief Jason Horowitz, on Georgia Maloney's rise and the path she has carved out for Europe's far-right parties.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事、罗马分社社长杰森·霍洛维茨将讲述乔治亚·梅洛尼的崛起，以及她为欧洲极右翼政党开辟的道路。

sentences.en: Jason, the Daily team tells me that the show doesn't normally cover visits from foreign heads of state to the White House.
sentences.zh: 杰森，《每日简报》团队告诉我，节目通常不报道外国国家元首对白宫的访问。

sentences.en: But there was a state visit last week that surprised me, and you covered it.
sentences.zh: 但上周有一次国事访问让我感到惊讶，而你对此进行了报道。

sentences.en: Tell me about it.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So last week, President Biden welcomed Prime Minister Georgia Maloney of Italy to the White House.
sentences.zh: 上周，拜登总统在白宫欢迎了意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼。

sentences.en: And at first look, this seemed like a regular visit from a foreign head of state.
sentences.zh: 乍一看，这似乎只是外国国家元首的一次常规访问。

sentences.en: They seem in sync on several things.
sentences.zh: 他们在很多事情上似乎步调一致。

sentences.en: Georgia Maloney has been a rock-rib supporter of Ukraine and the war, and the United States appreciates that.
sentences.zh: 乔治亚·梅洛尼一直是乌克兰和这场战争的坚定支持者，美国对此表示赞赏。

sentences.en: She is considering pulling out of a infrastructure deal with China, which the United States has never liked.
sentences.zh: 她正在考虑退出与中国的基础设施协议，这是美国一直不喜欢的。

sentences.en: And so the United States appreciates that, too.
sentences.zh: 所以美国对此也表示赞赏。

sentences.en: And, you know, at first glance, again, it just seemed like your regular meeting between allies.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，再次重申，乍一看这就像盟友之间的常规会晤。

sentences.en: But if you take a step back and you look at what symbolically Maloney represents, it was much more interesting because Miss Maloney is not just any prime minister.
sentences.zh: 但如果你退后一步，看看梅洛尼在象征意义上代表了什么，就会发现这有趣得多，因为梅洛尼女士不仅仅是一位普通总理。

sentences.en: She is arguably the leader of the far right within Europe.
sentences.zh: 她可以说是欧洲极右翼的领袖。

sentences.en: Europe, and Italy has been sort of the hotbed of populism within Europe for years now.
sentences.zh: 多年来，欧洲，尤其是意大利，一直是欧洲民粹主义的温床。

sentences.en: And for many, she represents the culmination of that movement.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，她代表了那场运动的巅峰。

sentences.en: And even President Biden, when she was first elected last year, he was very wary of her election.
sentences.zh: 甚至连拜登总统在去年她刚当选时，也对她的当选持非常谨慎的态度。

sentences.en: And in the days after her victory, he publicly said that Maloney was a warning sign for the progress of the far right around the world.
sentences.zh: 在她获胜后的几天里，他公开表示梅洛尼是全球极右翼势力抬头的一个警示信号。

sentences.en: And so I think how she got to where she started from as that very hard right sort of symbol to where she is now, meeting with President Biden, that's an interesting story.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，她从最初那个极右翼的象征，走到今天与拜登总统会面，这本身就是一个有趣的故事。

sentences.en: Tell me that story.
sentences.zh: 讲讲这个故事吧。

sentences.en: How did Maloney go from someone the White House was clearly concerned about to someone they're rolling out the red carpet for?
sentences.zh: 梅洛尼是如何从一个让白宫明显担忧的人，变成一个让他们铺开红地毯迎接的人的？

sentences.en: Well, to understand Giorgio Maloney, you really have to understand the far right in Italy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，要了解乔治亚·梅洛尼，你真的必须了解意大利的极右翼。

sentences.en: And that starts with Benito Mussolini.
sentences.zh: 这要从贝尼托·墨索里尼说起。

sentences.en: He was the Italian dictator who got Italy into World War II, and he brought fascism not only to Italy, but to all of Europe.
sentences.zh: 他是将意大利带入二战的独裁者，他不仅将法西斯主义带到了意大利，也带到了整个欧洲。

sentences.en: So after the war, fascism is defeated, Mussolini is dead.
sentences.zh: 所以二战后，法西斯主义战败，墨索里尼死了。

sentences.en: But unlike Germany, where the Nazis were held accountable for their actions, Italy takes a different path and has a different story.
sentences.zh: 但与德国不同，德国的纳粹分子因其罪行被追究责任，而意大利走了一条不同的路，有着不同的故事。

sentences.en: Italy bans the support of fascism, but the people who were the fascists, they're allowed to stick around.
sentences.zh: 意大利禁止支持法西斯主义，但那些曾经的法西斯分子却被允许留下来。

sentences.en: They don't disappear.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有消失。

sentences.en: And they're allowed to form parties.
sentences.zh: 他们被允许组建政党。

sentences.en: So yes, those parties are marginalized, but they become entrenched in Italian society.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，这些政党虽然被边缘化，但它们在意大利社会中根深蒂固。

sentences.en: And that goes on for decades until the early 1990s, when a very young Giorgia Maloney, she's
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续了几十年，直到1990年代初，当时非常年轻的乔治亚·梅洛尼，她那时

sentences.en: only a teenager at that point, decides she wants to become a youth activist for this post-fascist far-right political party.
sentences.zh: 才十几岁，决定成为这个后法西斯极右翼政党的青年活动家。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this is clearly not a very sanitized or popular part of the political spectrum or Italian society.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然不是政治光谱或意大利社会中一个非常纯净或受欢迎的部分。

sentences.en: So how does Maloney get there?
sentences.zh: 那么梅洛尼是怎么加入的呢？

sentences.en: So Giorgia Maloney has a very interesting personal life story, and she shared it with me in an interview at a hotel restaurant in Sardinia last year.
sentences.zh: 乔治亚·梅洛尼有着非常有趣的个人生活故事，去年在撒丁岛一家酒店的餐厅里，她在采访中与我分享了这些。

sentences.en: Anyway, well, thank you for taking the time.
sentences.zh: 总之，谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: She's from a working class neighborhood, and she's raised by a single mother.
sentences.zh: 她来自一个工人阶级社区，由单亲母亲抚养长大。

sentences.en: And I read that your mom was a writer, right?
sentences.zh: 我读到过你母亲是一位作家，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: My mother has a very particular story.
sentences.zh: 我母亲的故事非常特别。

sentences.en: She wasn't so lucky in her life, so she did lots of jobs.
sentences.zh: 她一生不太走运，所以做过很多工作。

sentences.en: And as you know, I didn't, we didn't have a father.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，我没有，我们没有父亲。

sentences.en: My mother left us.
sentences.zh: 我母亲离开了我们。

sentences.en: Her father and her mother split.
sentences.zh: 她父母离婚了。

sentences.en: Her father took off to the Canary Islands.
sentences.zh: 她父亲去了加那利群岛。

sentences.en: So at the end, she was directing a shop, and it failed.
sentences.zh: 最后，她经营一家商店，但倒闭了。

sentences.en: So she was without nothing.
sentences.zh: 所以她一无所有。

sentences.en: And I don't know how, she began to write in the night a love story.
sentences.zh: 我不知道怎么回事，她开始在夜里写爱情故事。

sentences.en: Her mother, to make ends meet, took up writing romance novels.
sentences.zh: 为了维持生计，她母亲开始写浪漫小说。

sentences.en: And at the end, she wrote 144 of these small books like Harmony.
sentences.zh: 最后，她写了144本像《和谐》系列那样的短篇小说。

sentences.en: And wrote a lot of them, but even still.
sentences.zh: 写了很多，但即便如此。

sentences.en: And they failed too.
sentences.zh: 它们也失败了。

sentences.en: It was not a very lucrative venture.
sentences.zh: 那不是一门赚钱的生意。

sentences.en: She was not successful at the time.
sentences.zh: 她当时并不成功。

sentences.en: So, you know, Maloney comes from a very different point of view than many in the Italian political spectrum come from.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，梅洛尼的观点与意大利政治光谱中的许多人截然不同。

sentences.en: She felt that maybe she didn't fit in, but she found a home with the far-right post-fascist party, which was sort of born from the ashes of fascism.
sentences.zh: 她觉得也许自己不合群，但她在那个从法西斯主义灰烬中诞生的极右翼后法西斯政党中找到了归宿。

sentences.en: So, let me just pause there.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我在这里停一下。

sentences.en: Can you explain what you mean when you say post-fascist?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下你所说的“后法西斯”是什么意思吗？

sentences.en: What is post-fascism?
sentences.zh: 什么是后法西斯主义？

sentences.en: Yes, that's actually a tricky question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这其实是个棘手的问题。

sentences.en: So, post-fascism refers to far-right political parties and movements that can clearly trace their roots back to fascism and Mussolini.
sentences.zh: 后法西斯主义指的是那些能清晰追溯其根源至法西斯主义和墨索里尼的极右翼政党和运动。

sentences.en: So, when the first post-fascist party forms right after World War II, there's still within it a strong strain that had a skepticism of democracy.
sentences.zh: 所以，当第一个后法西斯政党在二战后成立时，其内部仍然存在一种强烈的怀疑民主的倾向。

sentences.en: There were still people who believed in politics through violence.
sentences.zh: 仍然有人相信通过暴力进行政治活动。

sentences.en: There's a nationalism, a very strong feeling that Italy should be first, a hatred of communism.
sentences.zh: 有一种民族主义，一种认为意大利应该至上的强烈情感，以及对共产主义的仇恨。

sentences.en: There's an embrace of the traditional family and of the church.
sentences.zh: 还有对传统家庭和教会的拥护。

sentences.en: But the question has long been how much parts of fascism lingered and how much Maloney is tinged by them and how much she ever embraced them.
sentences.zh: 但长期以来的问题是，法西斯主义的成分残留了多少，梅洛尼受其影响有多深，以及她曾经在多大程度上拥护过它们。

sentences.en: What is clear is that the young people drawn to this world, their political ancestors, the
sentences.zh: 显而易见的是，被这个世界吸引的年轻人，他们的政治祖先，那些

sentences.en: people they could draw a direct line to, those were people who had been disgraced, who were taboo, who had brought Italy into World War II and devastated the country.
sentences.zh: 他们可以直接追溯的人，都是些名誉扫地、被视为禁忌的人，是那些将意大利带入二战并摧毁了这个国家的人。

sentences.en: There were people who committed atrocities and passed racial laws.
sentences.zh: 这些人犯下了暴行，并通过了种族法。

sentences.en: So, these young people who all of a sudden found themselves drawn to this party, they say not for those terrible things, but for other reasons, for the traditional family, for the
sentences.zh: 所以，这些突然发现自己被这个政党吸引的年轻人，他们说不是为了那些可怕的事情，而是为了其他原因，为了传统家庭，为了

sentences.en: belief that Italy should be patriotic.
sentences.zh: 相信意大利应该爱国。

sentences.en: They needed to establish new heroes.
sentences.zh: 他们需要树立新的英雄。

sentences.en: They need to create new origin stories for themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们需要为自己创造新的起源故事。

sentences.en: And so, strangely enough, the Lord of the Rings ends up being an extremely powerful document or testament or Bible for that world.
sentences.zh: 所以，奇怪的是，《指环王》最终成为了那个世界极其强大的文献、遗嘱或圣经。

sentences.en: Wait, Lord of the Rings as in like the J.R.R.
sentences.zh: 等等，《指环王》是指J.R.R.

sentences.en: Tolkien epics with the hobbits and the elves, that stuff.
sentences.zh: 托尔金的史诗，关于霍比特人和精灵的那部作品吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Jason, it is a long time since I last read Lord of the Rings, but it's not exactly obvious to me how it relates or how it's appealing to the far right.
sentences.zh: 杰森，我上次读《指环王》是很久以前的事了，但我不太明白它与极右翼有什么关系，或者它为何对极右翼有吸引力。

sentences.en: Well, there's a lot of woods and mysticism and epic battles, but I think what matters to the far right youth at the time is that it gave them clear archetypes, warriors and regular
sentences.zh: 嗯，书里有很多森林、神秘主义和史诗般的战斗，但我认为当时对极右翼青年来说重要的是，它给了他们清晰的原型，战士和普通

sentences.en: folks, in the case of the books, hobbits, who are defending individual cultures.
sentences.zh: 民众——在书中就是霍比特人——他们都在捍卫各自的文化。

sentences.en: In the book, we're talking about elf culture or dwarf culture.
sentences.zh: 在书中，我们谈论的是精灵文化或矮人文化。

sentences.en: But in their mind, they're talking about Italy.
sentences.zh: 但在他们的脑海中，他们谈论的是意大利。

sentences.en: They're talking about Christian culture.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的是基督教文化。

sentences.en: They're thinking of all the people who have an interest in canceling out what they view to be historic Italian values.
sentences.zh: 他们想到的是所有那些试图抹杀他们所认为的历史性意大利价值观的人。

sentences.en: So, you're a huge Lord of the Rings fan, I found out.
sentences.zh: 所以我发现，你是个《指环王》的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I can tell you whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 你想知道什么我都能告诉你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Me, I read the book when I was 11 years old.
sentences.zh: 我11岁时就读过这本书。

sentences.en: And Maloney, being a hard right youth, looks to Lord of the Rings, and she still quotes it to this very day, as sort of a very clear way to see good and evil.
sentences.zh: 而作为极右翼青年的梅洛尼，她仰望《指环王》，直到今天她还在引用它，将其视为一种看待善恶的非常清晰的方式。

sentences.en: So, the Lord of the Rings in sort of right-wing Italian politics means something.
sentences.zh: 所以，《指环王》在某种程度上意味着意大利右翼政治的某种东西。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: I think that Tolkien could say better than us, we're a conservative, believes in it.
sentences.zh: 我认为托尔金比我们说得更好，我们是保守派，相信这一点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You find everything in that.
sentences.zh: 你在里面能找到一切。

sentences.en: There's lots of archetypes in it.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多原型。

sentences.en: And again, those archetypes in reality were no longer available to her and to the others in the youth groups of these post-fascist parties.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这些原型在现实中对她和这些后法西斯政党青年组织中的其他人来说已不再适用。

sentences.en: So, that's how the Lord of the Rings becomes so influential to them.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是《指环王》对他们产生如此大影响的原因。

sentences.en: And they actually dress up as hobbits at certain points when they go to school.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至在去学校时会打扮成霍比特人。

sentences.en: They would have codenames for each other because it was a world where they felt constantly in battle with the communists in the other part of town.
sentences.zh: 他们会给彼此起代号，因为那是一个他们觉得时刻与城里另一边的共产主义者交战的世界。

sentences.en: So, there was a war-like mentality, so they had codenames.
sentences.zh: 所以，有一种战争心态，因此他们有了代号。

sentences.en: And the codenames were often characters from Lord of the Rings.
sentences.zh: 而这些代号通常是《指环王》中的角色。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, how does she go from cosplay to professional politics?
sentences.zh: 那么，她是如何从角色扮演走向职业政治的？

sentences.en: So, right off the bat, she finds herself at home in this group of like-minded young people and activists.
sentences.zh: 所以，从一开始，她就在这群志同道合的年轻人和活动家中找到了归属感。

sentences.en: They're hitting the streets.
sentences.zh: 他们走上街头。

sentences.en: They're demonstrating.
sentences.zh: 他们进行示威。

sentences.en: They're giving speeches.
sentences.zh: 他们发表演讲。

sentences.en: They're putting up posters.
sentences.zh: 他们张贴海报。

sentences.en: They're ripping down the leftist posters.
sentences.zh: 他们撕毁左翼的海报。

sentences.en: They're out there every week and every day.
sentences.zh: 他们每周、每天都在外面活动。

sentences.en: And, you know, she's getting noticed.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她开始受到关注。

sentences.en: I mean, when a French TV crew comes to Rome,
sentences.zh: 我是说，当法国电视摄制组来到罗马时，

sentences.en: they interview her.
sentences.zh: 他们采访了她。

sentences.en: And one of the things that she says, which sort of comes back to haunt her decades later,
sentences.zh: 她所说的一件事，在几十年后又回来困扰她，

sentences.en: is that she describes Mussolini as a good politician and says, everything he did, he did for Italy.
sentences.zh: 那就是她形容墨索里尼是一位优秀的政治家，并说他所做的一切都是为了意大利。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: But regardless of whatever admiration Maloney may or may not have harbored for Mussolini in her youth, her party at the time was going through a major upheaval.
sentences.zh: 但无论梅洛尼年轻时对墨索里尼怀有怎样的钦佩，她当时的政党正在经历一场重大动荡。

sentences.en: It was trying to join a new coalition led by Silvio Berlusconi, the conservative mogul who was reorganizing Italian politics.
sentences.zh: 当时它正试图加入一个由西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼领导的新联盟，这位保守派大亨当时正在重组意大利政坛。

sentences.en: He had just become prime minister and he needed coalition partners.
sentences.zh: 他刚当选总理，需要联盟伙伴。

sentences.en: So either as an effort to rebrand or as a sign of sincere conversion, the party makes a real effort to distance themselves from fascism and Mussolini.
sentences.zh: 因此，无论是为了重塑品牌还是出于真诚的转变，该党确实努力让自己与法西斯主义和墨索里尼划清界限。

sentences.en: So she sounds like she's a rising star in the youth movement from the street up.
sentences.zh: 所以她听起来就像是从街头运动中成长起来的青年运动新星。

sentences.en: But where does she go once she has established herself as an ambitious, upwardly moving young activist?
sentences.zh: 但当她确立了自己作为一名雄心勃勃、积极进取的年轻活动家的地位后，她又该何去何从呢？

sentences.en: So she catches the eye of the party leader who recognizes a talent in her and he grooms her.
sentences.zh: 于是她引起了党魁的注意，对方发现了她的才华并开始培养她。

sentences.en: And then she wins a small seat in Rome government in 1998.
sentences.zh: 随后，她在1998年赢得了罗马政府的一个小席位。

sentences.en: But really, she remains a highly local and deeply unknown figure to the political establishment.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，她仍然是一个非常本土化且在政治建制派中鲜为人知的人物。

sentences.en: And when does she get her big break?
sentences.zh: 那么她什么时候才迎来重大转机呢？

sentences.en: So her big break comes in 2008.
sentences.zh: 她的重大转机出现在2008年。

sentences.en: And that's when another Berlusconi government is in charge in Italy.
sentences.zh: 那时意大利正处于另一个贝卢斯科尼政府的领导下。

sentences.en: And Maloney is brought in as the youngest minister at that time in the history of Italy.
sentences.zh: 梅洛尼被任命为意大利历史上当时最年轻的部长。

sentences.en: She's then 31 years old.
sentences.zh: 那时她才31岁。

sentences.en: And she becomes the minister for youth affairs for all of Italy.
sentences.zh: 她成为了全意大利的青年事务部长。

sentences.en: And she becomes sort of a fixture of Italian politics.
sentences.zh: 她也因此成为了意大利政坛的一种常态。

sentences.en: But by 2012, she's ready to strike out on her own.
sentences.zh: 但到了2012年，她准备自立门户了。

sentences.en: She decides with a few others to leave Berlusconi's big tent to form her own political party.
sentences.zh: 她决定与其他人一起离开贝卢斯科尼的“大帐篷”联盟，组建自己的政党。

sentences.en: And they call it the Brothers of Italy.
sentences.zh: 他们将其命名为“意大利兄弟党”。

sentences.en: What are some of the things that she's calling for in her new party?
sentences.zh: 她在新政党中提出了哪些主张？

sentences.en: So when the populace are really ascending, everyone's sort of trying to outdo one another and be more extreme than the other.
sentences.zh: 当民粹主义真正兴起时，每个人都在试图胜过对方，表现得比别人更极端。

sentences.en: And Maloney is very much part of this.
sentences.zh: 而梅洛尼正是其中的重要一员。

sentences.en: When it comes to migration, she's saying that migrant ships should be sunk.
sentences.zh: 在移民问题上，她声称应该击沉移民船只。

sentences.en: Though she's very clear always that the migrant should be off the ships when it comes time to sink them.
sentences.zh: 尽管她总是明确表示，在击沉船只时，移民应该已经离开了船。

sentences.en: She commemorates the 100th anniversary of World War I by running a video in which there are an empire of invaders coming into Italy.
sentences.zh: 她通过播放一段视频来纪念第一次世界大战100周年，视频中描绘了一个入侵意大利的帝国。

sentences.en: And the invaders are Wall Street and they're Soros and they're Macron and they're Merkel.
sentences.zh: 而入侵者是华尔街、索罗斯、马克龙和默克尔。

sentences.en: So it's the European Union and it's the banking interests who are the invaders who are trying to ruin Italy.
sentences.zh: 所以，欧盟和银行利益集团就是那些试图摧毁意大利的入侵者。

sentences.en: And this wilderness period continues for Maloney and she keeps trying to look for an issue to gain popularity on.
sentences.zh: 梅洛尼的这段“荒野时期”仍在继续，她不断寻找能获得人气的话题。

sentences.en: And how does it go?
sentences.zh: 结果如何呢？

sentences.en: How's her party received in Italian politics and society at the time?
sentences.zh: 当时她的政党在意大利政治和社会中反响如何？

sentences.en: Is she succeeding?
sentences.zh: 她成功了吗？

sentences.en: Doesn't go terrific.
sentences.zh: 情况并不太妙。

sentences.en: The party is sort of relegated to the margins.
sentences.zh: 该党被边缘化了。

sentences.en: Polite society sees them as unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 主流社会认为他们是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Even though she is clearly, as I said, not alone in this space.
sentences.zh: 尽管正如我所说，她在这个领域显然并不孤单。

sentences.en: She's just not winning it.
sentences.zh: 只是她没能赢得支持。

sentences.en: She's stuck in the low single digits and she's not doing very well.
sentences.zh: 她的支持率一直徘徊在个位数，表现并不理想。

sentences.en: So she's really just looking for any issue that she can to gain some political traction.
sentences.zh: 所以她真的只是在寻找任何能获得政治影响力的议题。

sentences.en: And she keeps giving speeches and these speeches.
sentences.zh: 她不断地发表演讲，就是这些演讲。

sentences.en: She has a very particular speaking style.
sentences.zh: 她有一种非常独特的演讲风格。

sentences.en: I think the safest way to describe it is full of energy.
sentences.zh: 我认为最稳妥的描述就是充满活力。

sentences.en: So one of these speeches that she gives in Rome really hits a nerve.
sentences.zh: 她在罗马发表的其中一次演讲确实触动了人们的神经。

sentences.en: And it is in opposition to identity politics.
sentences.zh: 那是对身份政治的反对。

sentences.en: So she gives this speech in which she bellows.
sentences.zh: 她在演讲中大声疾呼。

sentences.en: I am Georgia.
sentences.zh: 我是乔治亚。

sentences.en: I am a woman.
sentences.zh: 我是个女人。

sentences.en: I am a mother.
sentences.zh: 我是个母亲。

sentences.en: I am Italian.
sentences.zh: 我是意大利人。

sentences.en: I am Christian.
sentences.zh: 我是基督徒。

sentences.en: And one of the main parts of the speech is she rails against this idea that gay couples can adopt children or have children through surrogacy.
sentences.zh: 演讲的主要内容之一是她抨击了同性伴侣可以领养孩子或通过代孕生子的想法。

sentences.en: And on the birth certificates, instead of mother and father, it says parent one, parent two.
sentences.zh: 而且在出生证明上，不再写母亲和父亲，而是写家长一、家长二。

sentences.en: So this speech did not go unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 所以这段演讲引起了广泛关注。

sentences.en: It was seen as hyperbolic.
sentences.zh: 它被认为过于夸张。

sentences.en: A lot of people on the left and even the center and even some of her allies on the right sort of teased her about it.
sentences.zh: 左翼、中间派，甚至她右翼的一些盟友都以此取笑她。

sentences.en: And it was considered so much of a joke that some house DJs decided to put it on a dance track.
sentences.zh: 这甚至被当作一个笑话，一些家庭DJ决定把它做成了一首舞曲。

sentences.en: And the chorus of the song is Georgia Maloney saying,
sentences.zh: 这首歌的副歌就是乔治亚·梅洛尼在说：

sentences.en: parent one, parent two, parent one, parent two in Italian.
sentences.zh: 意大利语的“家长一，家长二，家长一，家长二”。

sentences.en: And that song was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 那首歌到处都在放。

sentences.en: In fact, she says in her book, she said that these DJs made a mistake is that they made the song too good and too danceable.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她在书中说，这些DJ犯了一个错误，就是把歌做得太好听、太适合跳舞了。

sentences.en: And it went everywhere.
sentences.zh: 于是它传遍了各地。

sentences.en: And her message went everywhere.
sentences.zh: 她的信息也随之传遍了各地。

sentences.en: And her popularity went up.
sentences.zh: 她的人气也随之上升。

sentences.en: Now, I don't think that this song on the radio is what caused Georgia Maloney to catapult into power.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这首电台歌曲是乔治亚·梅洛尼一跃成为权力核心的原因。

sentences.en: But I also don't think that it's completely irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 但我也不认为它完全无关。

sentences.en: I think that it was Georgia Maloney being everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是因为乔治亚·梅洛尼无处不在。

sentences.en: And it was Georgia Maloney not being dangerous.
sentences.zh: 而且乔治亚·梅洛尼看起来并不危险。

sentences.en: So she has this inadvertent hit.
sentences.zh: 所以她意外地获得了一个热门话题。

sentences.en: Where does she go from there?
sentences.zh: 从那以后她又做了什么？

sentences.en: The key thing that happens for Georgia Maloney is that during the bleak years of COVID,
sentences.zh: 对乔治亚·梅洛尼来说，关键的转折点是在新冠疫情那段阴暗的岁月里，

sentences.en: Italy formed what is called a national unity government, which is basically everyone got in the government because it was such a major challenge to the country
sentences.zh: 意大利组建了所谓的“民族团结政府”，基本上每个人都加入了政府，因为这对国家来说是一个巨大的挑战，

sentences.en: that everyone needed to be a part of it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都需要参与其中。

sentences.en: And so her competition in the populist space enters this government.
sentences.zh: 于是，她在民粹主义领域的竞争对手加入了这个政府。

sentences.en: Georgia Maloney stays out of this government.
sentences.zh: 乔治亚·梅洛尼则置身事外。

sentences.en: And so when that government ultimately, as governments in Italy often do, collapsed, all of a sudden she is left alone.
sentences.zh: 因此，当那个政府最终像意大利政府常有的那样垮台时，她突然变得孤身一人。

sentences.en: And her former competitors are now tinged with, you know, this deadly establishmentism, right?
sentences.zh: 而她以前的竞争对手现在被染上了那种致命的“建制派”色彩，对吧？

sentences.en: They are seen as cooperating with all the people that they have sworn that they would fight.
sentences.zh: 他们被视为与他们发誓要对抗的所有人合作。

sentences.en: And their support plunges and her support takes off.
sentences.zh: 他们的支持率暴跌，而她的支持率却飙升。

sentences.en: And it didn't hurt her that the Italian left tried to frame her as a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 意大利左翼试图给她贴上“法西斯”的标签，这对她并没有造成伤害。

sentences.en: Italian voters didn't believe that.
sentences.zh: 意大利选民并不相信这一点。

sentences.en: They knew Georgia Maloney.
sentences.zh: 他们了解乔治亚·梅洛尼。

sentences.en: She was a known quantity on the stage.
sentences.zh: 她是政坛上的一个熟面孔。

sentences.en: And so to all of a sudden say, oh, you can't elect her.
sentences.zh: 所以突然说，哦，你不能选她。

sentences.en: She's a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 她是法西斯。

sentences.en: When she had been working with some of the people who were calling her a fascist for years, seemed disingenuous and helped her too.
sentences.zh: 当她多年来一直与那些称她为法西斯的人共事时，这种说法显得虚伪，反而帮了她。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, Georgia Maloney, who was for years, you know, stuck in the single digits, was by far the most popular politician in the country.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，多年来一直徘徊在个位数的乔治亚·梅洛尼，成为了全国最受欢迎的政治人物。

sentences.en: And there was an election for the first time in five years on the immediate horizon.
sentences.zh: 而五年来的首次选举即将在眼前举行。

sentences.en: She wins the elections and she becomes the first woman to be the prime minister of Italy.
sentences.zh: 她赢得了选举，成为意大利第一位女总理。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, all of Europe is looking at Georgia Maloney.
sentences.zh: 突然间，整个欧洲都在注视着乔治亚·梅洛尼。

sentences.en: And they have a big question.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个大问题。

sentences.en: What is Georgia Maloney actually going to do as prime minister after years of saying all the things that she has been saying?
sentences.zh: 在说了这么多年那些话之后，乔治亚·梅洛尼作为总理到底会做什么？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一个关于设计之爱及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在黑胶唱片时代做夜店DJ时，每天晚上你都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把DJ台变成了一个活生生的、充满50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《连接》游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责制作《拼字蜜蜂》和《字母框》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: So Jason, for the first time since Mussolini, there is a far-right politician leading Italy.
sentences.zh: 杰森，自墨索里尼以来，意大利首次由极右翼政治家领导。

sentences.en: How does Maloney govern when she gets to power?
sentences.zh: 梅洛尼上台后是如何执政的？

sentences.en: Does she stay true to her more extreme ideas?
sentences.zh: 她是否坚持了她那些更极端的想法？

sentences.en: So when Maloney takes office, there was apprehension all across Europe of what she would be like.
sentences.zh: 当梅洛尼上任时，整个欧洲都对她会是什么样子感到担忧。

sentences.en: And so when she goes into these sort of halls of Brussels and meets with these other leaders,
sentences.zh: 所以当她走进布鲁塞尔的那些大厅与其他领导人会面时，

sentences.en: people around the continent were surprised that Georgia Maloney didn't present as a fire-breathing dragon, the one that they had read about.
sentences.zh: 欧洲大陆的人们惊讶地发现，乔治亚·梅洛尼并没有表现得像他们读到的那样是一条喷火龙。

sentences.en: And on the major issues, she was playing within their rules, on economic issues.
sentences.zh: 在经济等重大问题上，她是在他们的规则内行事。

sentences.en: And most importantly, on Ukraine, she is not wavering.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在乌克兰问题上，她毫不动摇。

sentences.en: She is an absolute supporter of Ukraine against Russian aggression.
sentences.zh: 她是乌克兰对抗俄罗斯侵略的绝对支持者。

sentences.en: This is something that a lot of people were worried about.
sentences.zh: 这是很多人曾经担心的问题。

sentences.en: They were questioning whether she was just saying this in the campaign to seem more acceptable.
sentences.zh: 他们质疑她是否只是在竞选期间为了显得更容易被接受才这么说。

sentences.en: And right away, she made it absolutely clear she was not going to change.
sentences.zh: 而她立刻明确表示，她不会改变立场。

sentences.en: And so this immediately put people at ease in Europe.
sentences.zh: 这让欧洲的人们立刻感到安心。

sentences.en: It especially put people at ease in the White House.
sentences.zh: 这尤其让白宫的人感到安心。

sentences.en: So that's sort of the most important sign that, oh, wait, I think this might be okay.
sentences.zh: 所以这是最重要的信号，让人觉得，哦，等等，我想这可能没问题。

sentences.en: And on the issue of migration, she's arguably become a leader in Europe on the issue.
sentences.zh: 在移民问题上，她可以说是欧洲该议题的领导者。

sentences.en: She's holding conferences with lots of nations, not just in Europe, but in Africa and the Middle East,
sentences.zh: 她正在与许多国家举行会议，不仅是在欧洲，还有非洲和中东，

sentences.en: raising money to aid development in the countries that are the source of migration.
sentences.zh: 筹集资金以援助移民来源国的发展。

sentences.en: She is striking deals with leaders in North Africa to keep migrants from coming to Europe.
sentences.zh: 她正在与北非领导人达成协议，以阻止移民进入欧洲。

sentences.en: And she says she's doing this because she's trying to save the migrants at sea.
sentences.zh: 她说她这样做是因为她试图在海上拯救移民。

sentences.en: Critics say that she really just wants the migrants out of Italy and that she's pushing for a harsh policy to crack down even more on asylum seekers' rights.
sentences.zh: 批评者认为，她其实只是想把移民赶出意大利，并且正在推动严厉的政策，进一步打击寻求庇护者的权利。

sentences.en: But what's clear is that Maloney, who was a bomb thrower from the margins, is now playing a central role in Europe's migration policy.
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的是，曾经在边缘地带投掷炸弹的梅洛尼，现在在欧洲的移民政策中扮演着核心角色。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So as prime minister, she's basically governing and speaking like a run-of-the-mill conservative.
sentences.zh: 所以作为总理，她基本上是在以一个普通保守派的方式执政和发言。

sentences.en: And I guess, granted, the EU conservative movement has also lurched to the right, too.
sentences.zh: 我想，诚然，欧盟的保守派运动也已经向右倾斜了。

sentences.en: But I'm guessing that her base is still in part far-right.
sentences.zh: 但我猜她的基本盘在某种程度上仍然是极右翼。

sentences.en: How does she keep her core voters happy?
sentences.zh: 她如何让她的核心选民满意？

sentences.en: How does she ensure that they don't feel abandoned?
sentences.zh: 她如何确保他们不会感到被抛弃？

sentences.en: Well, I think this goes back to Maloney's credibility.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这要回到梅洛尼的信誉问题上。

sentences.en: She spent her time coming up the ranks.
sentences.zh: 她花时间一步步往上爬。

sentences.en: She was actually out on the streets living it, breathing it.
sentences.zh: 她确实是在街头摸爬滚打过来的。

sentences.en: So I don't think her hard-right base has any questions about her.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为她的极右翼基本盘对她没有任何疑问。

sentences.en: But she's also been careful to dole out some red meat to keep them satisfied.
sentences.zh: 但她也小心翼翼地抛出一些“红肉”来满足他们。

sentences.en: After a court ruling, her government has cracked down on same-sex couples that have tried to have children through surrogacy.
sentences.zh: 在一项法院裁决后，她的政府打击了试图通过代孕生子的同性伴侣。

sentences.en: And her government is actually erasing the names of those parents from birth certificates, saying, as her song said, you can't have parent one and parent two.
sentences.zh: 她的政府实际上正在从出生证明上抹去这些家长的名字，正如她的歌中所唱，你不能有家长一和家长二。

sentences.en: There has to be a mother and a father because she insists that's the only way a child should be born.
sentences.zh: 必须有母亲和父亲，因为她坚持认为这是孩子出生的唯一方式。

sentences.en: And her priority in government, she has said, is to raise the Italian birth rate.
sentences.zh: 她说，她在政府中的首要任务是提高意大利的出生率。

sentences.en: And that's sort of an existential problem for Italy.
sentences.zh: 这对意大利来说是一个生存问题。

sentences.en: They have the oldest population in Europe and have a very low birth rate.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有欧洲最老龄化的人口，出生率非常低。

sentences.en: But for a lot of her liberal critics, it raises alarm bells because it's something that the fascist government cared a lot about.
sentences.zh: 但对于许多自由派批评者来说，这敲响了警钟，因为这是法西斯政府曾经非常关心的事情。

sentences.en: The idea was a traditional Italian family, populating the country with lots of Italian babies, and that that was the way you projected power was also through population.
sentences.zh: 当时的理念是传统的意大利家庭，用大量的意大利婴儿充实国家，而这也是通过人口来投射力量的方式。

sentences.en: And so Maloney emphasizing birth rate, even though really it's something that is agreed upon across the political spectrum, has made some people uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 因此，梅洛尼强调出生率，尽管这实际上是整个政治光谱都同意的事情，但还是让一些人感到不安。

sentences.en: So, Jason, Maloney as a far-right European leader actually looks quite unusual.
sentences.zh: 所以，杰森，作为极右翼欧洲领导人的梅洛尼，看起来确实很不寻常。

sentences.en: First of all, unlike all other far-right leaders in Europe, she wins.
sentences.zh: 首先，与其他欧洲极右翼领导人不同的是，她赢了。

sentences.en: She gains power.
sentences.zh: 她获得了权力。

sentences.en: But it also feels that once in power, she starts to chart a more moderate path, maybe not fully at home, of course, but definitely internationally.
sentences.zh: 但人们也感觉到，一旦掌权，她就开始走上一条更温和的道路，当然在国内可能还没完全做到，但在国际上绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And I wonder, is she creating a new template for other far-right parties in Europe or other leaders like Marine Le Pen in France?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，她是否正在为欧洲其他极右翼政党或像法国的玛丽娜·勒庞这样的领导人开创一种新的模式？

sentences.en: You know, I think that Maloney has sort of become evidence to be used on both sides of the biggest debate going on in Europe right now,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为梅洛尼已经成为欧洲目前最大辩论中双方都可以利用的证据，

sentences.en: which is there's this eruption of far-right parties, and what is the best way to deal with them?
sentences.zh: 那就是极右翼政党的爆发，以及应对它们的最佳方式是什么？

sentences.en: So, one side would say what you need to do is marginalize them.
sentences.zh: 所以，一方会说你需要做的是边缘化他们。

sentences.en: We need to get rid of them, keep them taboo, which has been the way Europe has handled this since World War II.
sentences.zh: 我们需要摆脱他们，让他们成为禁忌，这正是二战以来欧洲处理这一问题的方式。

sentences.en: And then the other side says they are coming up too often, too faSt.
sentences.zh: 而另一方则说，他们出现得太频繁、太快了。

sentences.en: They're all over the place.
sentences.zh: 他们无处不在。

sentences.en: They're in France.
sentences.zh: 他们在法国。

sentences.en: They're in Finland.
sentences.zh: 他们在芬兰。

sentences.en: They're in Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们在西班牙。

sentences.en: They're all over Europe.
sentences.zh: 他们遍布整个欧洲。

sentences.en: The only way to handle this is to normalize them, to bring them in, to bring them into government.
sentences.zh: 处理此事的唯一方法是让他们正常化，把他们拉进来，让他们进入政府。

sentences.en: And so, the people who would make that argument would point to Georgia Maloney and say, see, here's Georgia Maloney.
sentences.zh: 因此，持这种观点的人会指着乔治亚·梅洛尼说，看，这就是乔治亚·梅洛尼。

sentences.en: She was the most far-right of the far-right politicians.
sentences.zh: 她曾是极右翼政客中最极右的一个。

sentences.en: And now, she's in government, and she's governing like a normal center-right conservative.
sentences.zh: 而现在，她身处政府之中，并且像一个正常的中间偏右保守派那样执政。

sentences.en: She has been normalized by reality, by the constraints of budgets, by the constraints of foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 她已经被现实、预算的限制以及外交政策的限制所正常化了。

sentences.en: That is the cure here to this fever.
sentences.zh: 这就是治疗这种狂热的良药。

sentences.en: That's what that side of the debate would say.
sentences.zh: 这就是辩论中那一方会说的话。

sentences.en: So, it sounds like this new approach that you've just outlined, to let the far-right in in order to normalize them, as opposed to ostracizing them,
sentences.zh: 所以，听起来你刚才概述的这种新方法，即让极右翼进入政府以使他们正常化，而不是排斥他们，

sentences.en: has kind of worked in Maloney's favor here.
sentences.zh: 在梅洛尼这里似乎奏效了。

sentences.en: I mean, here she is meeting with Biden and continuing to gain legitimacy on the international stage.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她在这里会见拜登，并继续在国际舞台上获得合法性。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it's definitely working for her.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这对她来说绝对有效。

sentences.en: I mean, she's got this coveted meeting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她得到了这次令人垂涎的会面。

sentences.en: But I think that from the White House perspective, you know, which, by the way, the United States has been willing to hold its nose to
sentences.zh: 但我认为从白宫的角度来看，顺便说一下，美国历史上一直愿意为了利益而忍气吞声，

sentences.en: plenty of dictators and unsavory characters throughout history.
sentences.zh: 去面对许多独裁者和令人不快的角色。

sentences.en: But in this case, I think that the United States feels that it has a dependable partner on the issues it cares about moSt.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，我认为美国觉得在它最关心的议题上，它有一个可靠的伙伴。

sentences.en: Jason, this leaves me wondering if she's truly moderated at some level, or if she hasn't, what that means for people or groups that she regularly targets.
sentences.zh: 杰森，这让我怀疑她是否在某种程度上真正变得温和了，或者如果她没有，这对她经常针对的人或群体意味着什么。

sentences.en: Well, I think it's hard to imagine that after, you know, decades in politics and decades steeped in hard-right ideology,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为很难想象，在经历了数十年的政治生涯和数十年的极右翼意识形态熏陶之后，

sentences.en: that Maloney has had a conversion within the last year to centrist politics.
sentences.zh: 梅洛尼在过去一年里会转变为中间派政治。

sentences.en: And there are plenty of people throughout Italy and Europe who remain very worried about what her intentions actually are, whether it be rolling back civil rights or gay rights,
sentences.zh: 在意大利和欧洲，仍有许多人对她的真实意图感到非常担忧，无论是撤销公民权利还是同性恋权利，

sentences.en: whether she intends to do something destructive to the European Union.
sentences.zh: 还是她是否打算对欧盟做出破坏性的举动。

sentences.en: She has, though, rejected her connections to some of the most vile parts of Italy's far-right paSt.
sentences.zh: 不过，她确实拒绝了她与意大利极右翼过去一些最卑劣部分的联系。

sentences.en: That's beyond doubt.
sentences.zh: 这一点毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: But still, it's complicated.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，情况还是很复杂。

sentences.en: People in her party keep getting caught acting in ways that, to put it mildly, seem very nostalgic for fascism, whether it be complimenting someone's swastika tattoo
sentences.zh: 她党内的人不断被发现做出一些行为，委婉地说，似乎对法西斯主义非常怀旧，无论是称赞某人的纳粹万字纹身，

sentences.en: or getting caught doing a fascist salute.
sentences.zh: 还是被抓到行法西斯礼。

sentences.en: When I talked to Maloney a year ago, just before she became prime minister, we talked about all this.
sentences.zh: 一年前，就在她成为总理之前，我和梅洛尼谈过，我们谈到了所有这些。

sentences.en: And I was very interested to hear from her how much she was willing to really break with that paSt.
sentences.zh: 我非常有兴趣听听她愿意在多大程度上真正与过去决裂。

sentences.en: What is your view of fascism and Mussolini now?
sentences.zh: 你现在对法西斯主义和墨索里尼有什么看法？

sentences.en: My view of fascism and Mussolini now is that it's what I said about 18 years, 15 years ago, not now,
sentences.zh: 我现在对法西斯主义和墨索里尼的看法，就是我大约18年前、15年前所说的，而不是现在，

sentences.en: that Russia laws, war, and the privation of freedom counts more than all the reSt.
sentences.zh: 即种族法、战争和剥夺自由比其他一切都重要。

sentences.en: And one of the things that I was interested in about is often people in that world, they will condemn Mussolini, and they will say he was terrible for Italy
sentences.zh: 我感兴趣的一点是，那个圈子里的人经常会谴责墨索里尼，他们会说他对意大利来说很糟糕，

sentences.en: because he got Italy into the Second World War, because he aligned with Hitler, and because he passed the racial laws.
sentences.zh: 因为他把意大利带入了第二次世界大战，因为他与希特勒结盟，因为他通过了种族法。

sentences.en: But then there's often a but.
sentences.zh: 但随后往往会有一个“但是”。

sentences.en: And the but is usually, but he did many great things, right?
sentences.zh: 而这个“但是”通常是，但他做了许多伟大的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: But he drained the swamps in Italy.
sentences.zh: 但他排干了意大利的沼泽。

sentences.en: But he, you know, passed welfare reforMs.
sentences.zh: 但他，你知道，通过了福利改革。

sentences.en: He did some good things, but my judgment about democracy,
sentences.zh: 他做了一些好事，但我的判断关于民主，

sentences.en: about the law, the Russian laws, was a negative one.
sentences.zh: 关于法律，关于种族法，是一个负面的判断。

sentences.en: We cannot know it.
sentences.zh: 我们无法知道。

sentences.en: But I pressed her.
sentences.zh: 但我追问了她。

sentences.en: We're cherry-picking policies, right?
sentences.zh: 我们是在挑选政策，对吧？

sentences.en: Regardless of all the caveats, did she think, not the historical judgment, but did she think that Mussolini was bad for Italy?
sentences.zh: 撇开所有的警告不谈，她是否认为，不是历史判断，而是她是否认为墨索里尼对意大利有害？

sentences.en: Like, the consensus historical view of Mussolini is that he was a bad figure in history and very bad for Italy.
sentences.zh: 就像关于墨索里尼的共识性历史观点是，他是一个糟糕的历史人物，对意大利非常有害。

sentences.en: Is that something you agree with?
sentences.zh: 你同意这一点吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Hmm?
sentences.zh: 嗯？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And in a sort of quiet voice, she said, yeah.
sentences.zh: 然后她用一种安静的声音说，是的。

sentences.en: And so a few months later, she's now prime minister.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，她现在成了总理。

sentences.en: And one of the first and most important things she does symbolically is that on Liberation Day in April, liberation from fascism, liberation from the Nazi-run puppet government,
sentences.zh: 她在象征意义上做的第一件也是最重要的事情之一是，在四月的解放日，即从法西斯主义中解放，从纳粹傀儡政府中解放出来的那天，

sentences.en: she writes an open letter to the country's largest newspaper.
sentences.zh: 她给该国最大的报纸写了一封公开信。

sentences.en: And in it, she says, quote, as any honest observer will acknowledge, the right-wing parties in parliament have declared their incompatibility with any nostalgia for fascism.
sentences.zh: 在信中，她说，引用如下：正如任何诚实的观察者所承认的那样，议会中的右翼政党已经宣布它们与任何对法西斯主义的怀旧情绪不相容。

sentences.en: So she was immediately trying to get rid of the shadow of fascism to cast it off of her.
sentences.zh: 所以她试图立即摆脱法西斯主义的阴影，将其从自己身上抛开。

sentences.en: But at the same time in this letter, she sort of dipped back into the old grievances of her and her friends being unfairly kept out of society for so long.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，在这封信中，她又回到了她和她的朋友们长期以来被不公平地排斥在社会之外的旧怨中。

sentences.en: So she's walking a fine line there.
sentences.zh: 所以她在那儿走钢丝。

sentences.en: She's walking a very fine line.
sentences.zh: 她走得非常小心。

sentences.en: Jason, thank you.
sentences.zh: 杰森，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Matina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，马蒂娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: In Pakistan on Sunday, an explosion at a political rally killed at least 35 people and wounded 200 more in the country's latest act of terrorism.
sentences.zh: 周日，巴基斯坦一场政治集会上发生爆炸，造成至少35人死亡，200人受伤，这是该国最新的恐怖主义行为。

sentences.en: The attack, believed to be a suicide bombing, occurred at an event organized by an Islamist party that is part of Pakistan's governing coalition.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击被认为是自杀式炸弹袭击，发生在由巴基斯坦执政联盟中的一个伊斯兰政党组织的活动上。

sentences.en: Militant groups have become more active in Pakistan over the last two years, since finding a haven in neighboring Afghanistan under Taliban rule.
sentences.zh: 过去两年里，激进组织在巴基斯坦变得更加活跃，因为它们在塔利班统治下的邻国阿富汗找到了避难所。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
